about: The HAX network's record: one entry per property, saying what it is called, where it lives, the color and icon that stand for it, what it is for and how it relates to the rest. Everything that names, draws or describes a property reads this, so the network says one thing about itself. color and on are DDD color names (the fill, and the ink that reads on it). icon is a plain simple-icon for places that cannot draw the property's own network icon. order is the order the network bar lists them; RPG me comes after them, as your character.

web.label: HAXTheWeb

cloud.relation: PRAW, at hax.cloud, drawn as a web. Every other property takes its stories from here.
